title: Review
description: A PR-gate review verdict, optionally with per-reviewer findings. Current rigor tiers come from core/policy/gate-tiers.tsv. The schema_version 1 `targeted` tier value is retained only to validate legacy payloads; targeted remediation is now a pass kind. `findings_path` points at .gate-results/<gate-id>/<reviewer>.{json,md} — Review row is the INDEX, not the data.

run_id.description: Optional link to the Run that triggered the gate.

tier.description: Current editing source: core/policy/gate-tiers.tsv. `targeted` is a schema_version 1 compatibility value and must not be emitted by new producers.

reviewer.description: Editing source-of-truth: core/policy/reviewer-policy.yaml. Keep in sync.

verdict.description: Editing source-of-truth: core/policy/reviewer-policy.yaml. Keep in sync.

findings_path.description: Path to the reviewer's full output. .gate-results/<gate-id>/<reviewer>.{json,md}.

override_path.description: Path to override-justification doc when user overrides a hard-gate block.
